paper_metadata.title: Preparation of WE54 alloy with excellent mechanical properties by hard-tube rotary swaging and aging treatment

evidence.quote: This study prepared a WE54 alloy with excellent mechanical properties through hard-tube rotary swaging and aging treatment.

After aging at 225 ◦ C for 6 h, the RT-RS alloy exhibits optimal mechanical properties, with a tensile strength of 465 MPa, a yield strength of 424 MPa, and an elongation of 4.5 %.
The ingot was heated at 520 ◦ C for 8 h to decompose the eutectic phase formed during solidification, thus weakening the deformation resistance and making it easier to achieve extrusion [27].
Before extrusion, the ingot was preheated at 460 ◦ C for 30 min. Then, the WE54 alloy ingot was extruded at a temperature of 460 ◦ C, under an extrusion speed of 1 mm/s and an extrusion ratio of 16.

The extruded rods were further processed via multi-pass hard-tube rotary swaging at 420 ◦ C and ambient temperature. The spindle revolution is 350 rpm during the swaging process, and the forming feed is 10 mm/s.
For the sample swaged at 420 ℃ , the extruded bar was held at 420 ◦ C for 30 min before rotary swaging, and the sample was annealed at 420 ◦ C for 15 min between passes.
An annealing treatment was performed on the as-swaged alloys at 300 ◦ C for 30 min. The short-time annealing treatment aims to eliminate residual stresses and avoid the growth of grains.
The swaged alloys were followed by an aging treatment at 225 ◦ C.

Before extrusion, the ingot was preheated at 460 ◦ C for 30 min. Then, the WE54 alloy ingot was extruded at a temperature of 460 ◦ C, under an extrusion speed of 1 mm/s and an extrusion ratio of 16.
For the sample swaged at room temperature, the extruded bar was first held at 420 ◦ C for 30 min, followed by rotary swaging at room temperature without any annealing treatment between passes.
An annealing treatment was performed on the as-swaged alloys at 300 ◦ C for 30 min. The short-time annealing treatment aims to eliminate residual stresses and avoid the growth of grains.
After aging at 225 ◦ C for 6 h, the RT-RS alloy exhibits optimal mechanical properties, with a tensile strength of 465 MPa, a yield strength of 424 MPa, and an elongation of 4.5 %.
